basic_info.name: Ollie
basic_info.description: Ollie is the production eval layer for long-horizon agents.For coding agents, browser and computer-use agents, support agents, knowledge-work agents, and other tool-using systems, completing a workflow is not the same as achieving the correct outcome.The most damaging failures are often silent. Nothing crashes. Latency looks normal. Every tool call appears successful. But the agent skipped a constraint, lost context, followed the wrong path, or delivered the wrong result.Ollie evaluates complete production trajectories—from the user’s initial intent to the agent’s final outcome. It detects recurring behavioral failures across runs, scopes the affected sessions, traces the shared failing path and likely root cause, and gives engineering teams clear answers to three questions:What went wrong?Why did it go wrong?How do we fix it?Ollie then closes the loop between production and evaluation. It generates candidate fixes, tests them against real failed trajectories, keeps engineers in the approval loop, and converts production failures into regression cases for offline eval suites.Every failure discovered in production becomes an opportunity to strengthen both the agent and the tests designed to evaluate it.Ollie is built for staff and principal engineers, AI engineers, applied AI researchers, and platform teams shipping agents at scale. It complements existing observability and evaluation stacks by connecting production failure detection, root-cause analysis, remediation, and regression prevention in one workflow.Catch the silent failure. Find the root cause. Fix the agent. Update the eval. Before customers complain.Learn more at https://tryollie.com/
